annotations.title: Check a record before you paste it

description: Tests a DNS record someone gave you (from a chatbot, a DNS host or a web person) against the domain's live records before it is published: SPF lookups and dropped senders, DMARC that would block your own mail, DKIM keys, MX moves, CNAME clashes. Says safe, careful or stop. Never publishes anything.

domain.description: A domain name, for example yourbusiness.com

host.description: Optional: the host or name field, if it was given separately

record.description: The record as you were given it, for example: TXT _dmarc "v=DMARC1; p=reject"

name: check_record
title: Check a record before you paste it
